descriptionChirho: The Hebrew proper masculine name יִשְׁמָעֵאל (Yishmael/Ishmael), meaning 'God hears' (from שָׁמַע + אֵל). Refers to multiple individuals in Scripture: (1) the son of Abraham and Hagar, progenitor of the Ishmaelite tribes (Gen 16-25), who received divine promises of great nationhood; (2) the son of Nethaniah who assassinated Gedaliah governor of Judah (2 Kgs 25:25, Jer 40-41); and (3) several minor figures in Chronicles and Ezra. Rendered as Ismael/Jischmael in German, Ismael in French, إِسْمَاعِيل in Arabic (preserving the Semitic cognate), and इश्माएल in Hindi. The 48 total occurrences include bare forms, prepositional constructions (ל-ישמעאל), and conjunctive forms (ו-ישמעאל), all representing the same proper name.
